source_statement: Let O1 and O2 be concentric circles with radii 4 and 6, respectively. A chord AB is drawn in O1 with length 2. Extend AB to intersect O2 in points C and D. Find CD.

clause_ledger.dsl: C,D share the same carrier y=h and lie on the radius-6 circle; order guards
